name: Aiyana Brown
source:
Tarot: The Hermit
Music Genre: Vocaloid, EDM, Maidcore
Likes: Doujinshi, erotica, being taken care of
Dislikes: Public arguments, structured jobs, psychology students

Aiyana dislikes socializing because her lack of understanding of societal structures 
always causes her to experience humiliation, distress, or participate in relationships 
that leave her with negative feelings.
                
She sorts out her thoughts methodically, trying to write most of them down. 
She encourages others to do the same. 
She communicated with her mother through notes often.

Dislikes when someone assumes how she's feeling. Experiences alexithymia. 
Really likes Adelaide post college because she is such an empathetic and blunt person. 
Same with Eva.

[From in-game profile]
